hero.title: Track any expense in any currency.
hero.sub: Talk to your money. Manilo (formerly Ledgy) is a multi-currency expense tracker for iOS. Log by voice on your iPhone or Apple Watch, snap a receipt, or ask Claude and ChatGPT directly. Free to download. No ads. Your data stays on your device unless you turn on Cloud.

trust.offline: Offline-first. Your data on your device.

how.title: Three steps. Then never again.
how.sub: Capture is whatever's fastest in the moment. Manilo figures out the rest.

steps.title: Capture
steps.body: Voice on your watch, photo of a receipt, or a forwarded SMS in Telegram.

steps.title: Parse
steps.body: AI reads it, picks the right category, account, and group.

steps.title: See it everywhere

surfaces.title: Five ways in.
surfaces.sub: Whatever device is closest, that's the one Manilo uses. Everything ends up in the same ledger.

iphone.title: iPhone
iphone.body: Voice, photo, manual numpad, or paste-from-anywhere. One tap, one verb. Done.

watch.title: Apple Watch
watch.body: Hold the mic. Speak. Done in 5 seconds. Watch complications deep-link straight to record.

siri.title: Siri
siri.body: "Hey Siri, log expense to Manilo." App Intents on iOS 16+.

wallet.title: Apple Wallet
wallet.body: Apple Pay payments auto-log. Each card gets its own AI rule (e.g. "tag with Trip 2026").

telegram.title: Telegram bot
telegram.body: Text, photo, or voice in your chat. Inline pickers to fix anything in two taps.

aiAgent.title: AI Agent
aiAgent.body: Just say to your any AI agent you use (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini and others) what to record.

smart.title: The boring parts of money — handled.

ai.title: AI that learns your life
ai.body: Well-known categories, your custom ones, custom rules. Per-card Wallet rules so your "Travel" Visa always tags as Trip 2026.
checklist: Re-parses past transactions when you correct it

budgets.title: Budgets that watch your back
budgets.body: Per-category and overall, weekly / monthly / quarterly / yearly. They pulse red the moment you cross. No surprises.

fx.title: Multi-currency without the math
fx.body: Live FX. Tap and hold any amount to convert. Set a primary currency and Manilo translates the totals.
checklist: Daily-refreshed rates from a reliable source
Per-account currency, primary at the top

receipts.title: Receipts kept where they belong
receipts.body: Photo attach. Server-cloned to all members of a shared group, isolated to your namespace, deleted when you say so.
checklist: One tap to attach from camera or library
Encrypted at rest, isolated per user

mcp.sub: Connect Manilo to your favorite AI chat. Ask it anything in plain English — “what did I spend on coffee last month?” — and it answers from your own data. No copy-paste, no spreadsheets.
prompts: "What did I spend on coffee last month?"
"Am I on track for my groceries budget?"
mcp.note: Connect once, ask anything. Your AI only sees what you allow — you’re always in control, and you can disconnect any time.

sharing.sub: Join a family budget or trip group, and your transactions stay yours forever. Sharing decides who sees them — never who owns them. Leave the group, keep your history.

devices.title: Capture on the wrist. Analyze in the browser.
devices.sub: Same ledger, every device. The watch is for now, the dashboard is for later.

watch.title: Apple Watch
watch.body: Hold the digital crown. Speak. The transaction is on your phone before you put your wrist down.

dashboard.alt: The Manilo web dashboard showing monthly summary, spend by category, and budgets

items.a: Yes. Every screen reads from a local SQLite database on your phone. New transactions appear instantly; sync happens in the background when you're back online.
items.schemaA: Yes. Every screen reads from a local SQLite database on your phone. New transactions appear instantly; sync happens in the background when you are back online.

items.q: What happens to my data if I leave a shared group?
items.a: Nothing. Your transactions are personally owned — sharing only decides who sees them. Leave the group, keep your history.

items.q: Is my voice sent to a server?
items.a: No. Voice is transcribed on your device using Apple's on-device speech recognizer. Only the resulting text is sent to our AI for parsing.

items.q: Can I import from Mint / YNAB / another app?
items.schemaQ: Can I import from Mint, YNAB, or another app?
items.a: Yes. The CSV import wizard auto-detects column headers in 29 languages, currency symbols, and category aliases. Bring your full history.
14 fully translated locales: English, German, Spanish (Mexico), French, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, and Simplified Chinese.
